transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I can finalize the assignment, hospital policy requires me to hold a brief equipment-readiness check with physical therapy, facilities, nursing education, and infection prevention. I'd like to go through that check now so we can make a timely decision. Could each of you confirm your area's readiness and share any relevant concerns?
